headline: Diesel futures push toward $5 as refinery outages persist
intro: Diesel's on a tear again — ULSD just hit its highest mark since the April Iran-war spike, and with refinery outages piling up and futures flirting with $5, the crack spread math is starting to look brutal for anyone buying at the rack.
overview: Diesel cracks remain elevated near $107/bbl as US refinery outages and geopolitical risk — from Ukrainian strikes on Russian refining capacity to Trump's Venezuela push — keep tightening product supply. On the policy side, EPA's 29 small refinery exemptions continue to draw fire from biofuel and soybean groups, while Citgo moves ahead with a $310M gasoline-blending upgrade at Lake Charles. Meanwhile, Trump is publicly pressuring domestic refiners to boost gasoline and diesel output as pump prices stay elevated.

stories.title: Diesel Supply Tightens, Refinery Outages Continue And Futures Run Toward $5
stories.summary: Diesel supply is tightening with refinery outages continuing and ULSD futures running toward $5, while crude holds modest gains and RBOB hovers near breakeven.

stories.title: USA Diesel Hits Highest Since April
stories.summary: US diesel prices advanced to their highest level since the April peak during the initial phase of the US-Iran war.

stories.summary: EIA reported US crude oil inventories down 4.5 million bbl to 424.5 million bbl, about 1% above the five-year average.

stories.summary: TACenergy's Week 35 US DOE inventory recap for refined products.

stories.title: Citgo approves new processing unit for Lake Charles refinery
stories.summary: Citgo approved a $310 million processing unit at its Lake Charles refinery to improve naphtha upgrading and increase gasoline-blending component production.

stories.title: Russia’s LUKOIL Refinery Producing Up to 11% of Country’s Gasoline Shuts Down Following Ukraine Strike
stories.summary: Russia's LUKOIL Kstovo refinery, producing up to 11% of the country's gasoline, halted operations after a Ukrainian drone strike damaged processing and hydrotreatment units.

stories.summary: Russia's Novak called the recent oil output drop temporary even as drone strikes on refineries and export terminals reshape crude forecasts.

stories.title: Small refinery exemptions raise big questions

stories.title: Biofuel groups react to EPA refinery exemptions
stories.summary: Farm and biofuel organizations reacted with mixed views to EPA's decision to grant 29 small refinery exemptions from the RFS for 2025.

stories.title: Soybean farmers convinced EPA to change course on SRE expansion
stories.summary: Soybean farmers reportedly convinced EPA to maintain the status quo on RFS rules, avoiding a potential billion-dollar loss for US soybean farmers.

stories.summary: Lion Oil's El Dorado refinery was among 18 refineries receiving a full EPA exemption from 2025 Renewable Fuel Standard requirements.
